rationale: With only 7 minutes to close, the last candle showed a sharp drop from ~$66.42 to $65.42 on 91,153 shares — a sudden flush that could represent either capitulation or the start of further selling. The spread is wide at 50 bps, the stock has already gapped down ~6% from prior close and is near session lows, and any position opened now would be forcibly liquidated at market close in 7 minutes with no ability to manage risk properly. The risk/reward of entering into this volatile, end-of-day chop does not justify the capital commitment.
